title: Tamil Nadu Politics – Morning Brief – 1 November 2026
headline: ‘Administrative incompetence’ characterises TVK’s reign in the State, says Palaniswami

sections.big_picture:
- **AIADMK, TVK — ‘Administrative incompetence’ characterises TVK’s reign in the State, says Palaniswami:** Addressing a meeting in Maraimalai Nagar amid the 55th formation day celebrations of the AIADMK, the leader says even schemes launched by it, such as the marriage assistance scheme for women, were originally implemented during his party’s regime.
- **AIADMK, TVK — Palaniswami slams TVK-led government over convict’s escape in Coimbatore:** Palaniswami blasts TVK-led government over Coimbatore convict escape; criticizes law-and-order and power issues in Tamil Nadu.
- **DMK, TVK — Opposition slams TVK govt for repeated prison escapes across Tamil Nadu:** Prisoners are deciding whether to escape from Palayamkottai or Salem by playing ‘inky pinky ponky’: Udhayanidhi.
- **DMK, TVK — DMK women’s wing protests reflect public anger against TVK govt: Stalin:** ‘Statewide protests drew large numbers of women, including those not affiliated to any political party’.
- **AIADMK, TVK — Tamil Nadu CM Vijay is completely out of touch, lacks independent decision-making: EPS:** CHENGALPET: AIADMK general secretary and former chief minister Edappadi K Palaniswami (EPS) on Saturday launched a blistering attack on the TVK govt,.

sections.government_and_administration:
- **Tamil Nadu government withdraws cases against 1,800 anti-NEET protesters:** The Hindu also reported on the development: "Tamil Nadu government orders withdrawal of 65 cases against NEET protesters." ([DT Next](https://news.google.?oc=5))
- **Madras High Court Advocates Association challenges 1965 Union Cabinet decision to continue English as common language for Supreme Court and all High Courts:** Says, the 1965 decision came to its notice only in 2025 pursuant to details obtained by a lawyer under the Right to Information Act, 2005 ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/madras-high-court-advocates-association-challenges-1965-union-cabinet-decision-to-continue-english-as-common-language-for-supreme-court-and-all-high-courts/article71648537.ece))
- **HoDs now responsible for student placements in colleges and universities, says higher education department:** Tamil Nadu higher education circular makes HoDs lead student placements, industry tie-ups, internships and skill training; teacher bodies oppose amid 7,000 vacancies. ([The Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/hods-now-responsible-for-student-placements-in-colleges-and-universities-says-higher-education-department/articleshow/135405074.cms))
- **Minister inaugurates modern paddy storage facilities in Cuddalore district:** The facilities, constructed with financial assistance under the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD), have a combined storage capacity of 7,000 tonnes ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/minister-inaugurates-modern-paddy-storage-facilities-in-cuddalore-district/article71652117.ece))
sections.district_developments:
- **Two persons held for possession of country-made guns, explosives:** Two Vellore arrests for possession of country-made guns, explosives, and hunting gear linked to a farmer and a tribal man. ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/two-persons-held-for-possession-of-country-made-guns-explosives/article71649177.ece))
- **Man escapes from police custody before being lodged in Coimbatore Central Prison:** This is the second time Raghavan, a theft case convict, has escaped from police custody; four personnel suspended ([The Hindu](https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/tamil-nadu/convict-escapes-from-police-custody-before-being-lodged-in-coimbatore-central-prison/article71648346.ece))
- **Tamil Nadu shuts prison enterprises outside campuses, recalls around 400 warders to plugs security gaps:** Tamil Nadu shuts prison enterprises outside campuses after Theni jailbreak, recalling 300–400 warders to boost prison security; inside-campus industries continue. ([The Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/tamil-nadu-shuts-prison-enterprises-outside-campuses-recalls-around-400-warders-to-plugs-security-gaps/articleshow/135410725.cms))
- **Runaway schoolgirls from Vellore rescued in Chennai:** Two 16-year-old Vellore schoolgirls who ran away from Pernampattu were found near a Kilpauk hospital in Chennai and handed over to police; parents informed. ([The Times of India](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/chennai/runaway-schoolgirls-from-vellore-rescued-in-chennai/articleshow/135410333.cms))
